extracted.intended_audience: authors and reviewers participating in eLife's Reviewed Preprints (eLife Model)
extracted.subtask_short: peer review under the eLife Model
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting and handling manuscripts under eLife's Reviewed Preprints workflow, which publishes all peer-reviewed preprints with assessments and public reviews rather than making accept/reject decisions. Covers which submission system to use, what appears in a Reviewed Preprint, and how revisions are handled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication outcome: Reviewed Preprint (no accept/reject decision)
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the eLife Model, we no longer make accept/reject decisions after peer review. Instead, every preprint sent for peer review is published on the eLife website as a Reviewed Preprint.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions invited for peer review will be published as a Reviewed Preprint. There will be no accept/reject decision after review; reviewers and authors should therefore expect publication of the reviewed record rather than a binary editorial verdict.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contents of a Reviewed Preprint
rubrics_metrics.description: A Reviewed Preprint includes an eLife Assessment, public reviews, and a response from the authors (if available).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These elements (eLife Assessment, public reviews, author response) are published together as the Reviewed Preprint record. Reviewers should be aware their reviews will be made public as part of this record.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the new submission system for eLife Model submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Please use this submission system for new submissions to be considered for publication under the eLife Model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors submitting work to be handled under the eLife Model must use the specified submission system (not the legacy system) so the manuscript can enter the Reviewed Preprint workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resubmission and revision process (re-review and updates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please use this submission system to submit revisions of Reviewed Preprints. The manuscript will be re-reviewed and the Reviewed Preprint, eLife Assessment and public reviews will be updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Revisions are handled by re-review rather than by issuing accept/reject decisions; the public Reviewed Preprint record (including assessments and reviews) is updated to reflect subsequent reviews and author responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions: use of legacy submission system
rubrics_metrics.description: Use our legacy submission system for new submissions of Feature Articles and Scientific Correspondence, and for resubmissions of research papers submitted before January 31, 2023.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certain content types (Feature Articles, Scientific Correspondence) and older resubmissions are to be routed via the legacy system rather than the eLife Model submission system—authors should follow this routing guidance when submitting.
